content.body:
The Vickers Mark.VI actually formed a large bulk of Britains tank forces at the outset of the war. It was intended to be deployed as a reconnaissance vehicle ... and mainly for colonial low-intensity conflicts. Meant for infantry support only, their light armor could not withstand even close AP machinegun fire; historically many were thrust into the role of light battle tank with predictably high casualties. Note that the .50 caliber machinegun is not the impressive M2 .50 cal later brought into the war by the Americans, but simply a gun with similar .50 caliber bullets however also having poorer performance.
Control Variations: No driver periscope, but driver may zoom on open viewslit (numpad . or Del key). Closing view-slit armor blocks vision completely. Main gun is .50 caliber mg with co-ax .303 mg. AP ammunition only and no range adjustment or gradation available through gunsight.
The Vickers is a nimble, quick vehicle which can maintain a high speed even off road. Its green coloring makes it hard to spot in any sort of broken brush or against a tree-line. The question is why would you want to go into battle with a Vicky? There are very few strong points about this tank; the concentrated MG fire can provide a modicum of self-propelled anti-aircraft capability to an infantry assault, but the fountain of tracer fire will attract ATR soldiers, rifle grenadiers, and light tanks to your position like vultures to road kill.
Likewise it can provide some support for AT guns or other weapons that need to keep away the infantry, the Vickers having the standard AFV commanders binoculars that will help spot approaching enemies.
The .50 cal is not particularly accurate, so even moderate range fire requires long bursts to be effective. While it has trouble protecting itself from virtually any form of attack from an armoured vehicle, it is useful as a source of suppressive firepower for attacking infantry if no enemy armour is being faced down. The numbers present in the BEF battle order made it logically necessary for the Vickers to be included in the game, but it will almost certainly be your last choice as an armored vehicle to take on any mission.
content.brief: TYPE: Light AFV (tankette) ARMAMENT: 1 X .50 inch HMG 1 x .303 inch MG WEIGHT: 4877 kg SPEED (road): 51 km/h
content.title: Vickers Mk.VI
